<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Belly rub</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 240px; height: 246px; overflow: hidden; background: #2a1c19; }
  canvas { display: block; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 240px; height: 246px; }

</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const W = 240, H = 246, PXU = 39, CAMZ = 10, LOOP = 3200;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(W, H);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x2a1c19);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(2 * Math.atan(H / PXU / 2 / CAMZ) * 180 / Math.PI, W / H, 1, 60);
camera.position.set(0, 0, CAMZ);
camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

// ---------------- helpers ----------------
const V = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);
const UPV = V(0, 1, 0), DOWNV = V(0, -1, 0), FWDV = V(0, 0, 1);
const geoS = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16);
const geoB = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 32);
const mat = (c, r = 0.8) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: c, roughness: r, metalness: 0 });
const bm = (c) => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: c });

const C_GREEN = 0x97b85c, C_GPATCH = 0xe4c4b2, C_PINK = 0xf0a2bd, C_CREAM = 0xf7e5cd, C_HAND = 0x5c4030;
const mGreen = mat(C_GREEN), mPink = mat(C_PINK), mHand = mat(C_HAND, 0.7);
const mVC = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.8, metalness: 0 });
const mWhite = mat(0xf6f4ee, 0.4), mBlack = mat(0x15110f, 0.3);
const mMouthG = mat(0x4a5a28), mMouthP = mat(0xb65c7b), mTuft = mat(0xfbf3e4);

function ell(rx, ry, rz, m, g = geoS) { const o = new THREE.Mesh(g, m); o.scale.set(rx, ry, rz); return o; }
function at(o, x, y, z) { o.position.set(x, y, z); return o; }
function grp(name, ...kids) { const g = new THREE.Group(); g.name = name; for (const k of kids) g.add(k); return g; }
function sstep(a, b, x) { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }

function patchSphere(baseHex, patchHex, wfn, ws, hs) {
  const g = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, ws, hs);
  const p = g.attributes.position;
  const arr = new Float32Array(p.count * 3);
  const cb = new THREE.Color(baseHex), cp = new THREE.Color(patchHex), c = new THREE.Color();
  for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
    c.copy(cb).lerp(cp, wfn(p.getX(i), p.getY(i), p.getZ(i)));
    arr[i * 3] = c.r; arr[i * 3 + 1] = c.g; arr[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
  }
  g.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3));
  return g;
}
function surf(R, x, y) {
  const z = R[2] * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (x / R[0]) ** 2 - (y / R[1]) ** 2));
  return { p: V(x, y, z), n: V(x / (R[0] * R[0]), y / (R[1] * R[1]), z / (R[2] * R[2])).normalize() };
}
function makeEye(name, r, pr, ox = 0, oy = 0) {
  const g = grp(name);
  g.add(ell(r, r, r * 0.6, mWhite));
  g.add(at(ell(pr, pr, pr * 0.55, mBlack), ox, oy, r * 0.36));
  return g;
}
function makeHand(name, s) {
  const g = grp(name);
  g.add(at(ell(0.36 * s, 0.2 * s, 0.3 * s, mHand), 0.04 * s, 0, 0));
  for (const [x, z] of [[0.36, -0.2], [0.43, 0], [0.36, 0.2]]) {
    g.add(at(ell(0.17 * s, 0.12 * s, 0.11 * s, mHand), x * s, -0.03 * s, z * s));
  }
  g.add(at(ell(0.14 * s, 0.11 * s, 0.12 * s, mHand), 0.1 * s, -0.03 * s, -0.32 * s));
  return g;
}
function makeArm(side, L1, L2, r0, r1, r2, s) {
  const group = grp('arm-' + side);
  group.add(ell(r0, r0, r0, mGreen));
  group.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r0, r1, L1, 18, 1), mGreen), 0, -L1 / 2, 0));
  const fore = grp('forearm-' + side); fore.position.y = -L1; group.add(fore);
  fore.add(ell(r1, r1, r1, mGreen));
  fore.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r1, r2, L2, 18, 1), mGreen), 0, -L2 / 2, 0));
  const hand = makeHand('hand-' + side, s); hand.position.y = -L2; fore.add(hand);
  return { group, fore, hand, L1, L2 };
}
function limb(name, tipName, p0, p1, r, tr) {
  const g = grp(name); g.position.copy(p0);
  const d = p1.clone().sub(p0), len = d.length(), dn = d.clone().normalize();
  const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(r, len, 6, 16), mPink);
  c.position.copy(d).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  c.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UPV, dn);
  const tip = grp(tipName, ell(tr[0], tr[1], tr[2], mHand));
  tip.position.copy(d).addScaledVector(dn, r * 0.6);
  g.add(c, tip);
  return g;
}
function canvasTex(draw) {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; c.height = 64;
  draw(c.getContext('2d'));
  const t = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); t.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return t;
}

// ---------------- lights ----------------
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff4ea, 0x6b5148, 2.0));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.3));
const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff6ee, 1.6); keyLight.position.set(-2, 5, 8); scene.add(keyLight);
const backLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe4c8, 1.0); backLight.position.set(3, 4, -7); scene.add(backLight);
const lampLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffd8a0, 5, 0, 2); lampLight.position.set(0.55, 1.05, -3.3); scene.add(lampLight);

// ---------------- room ----------------
const room = grp('room'); scene.add(room);
const wallTex = canvasTex((g) => {
  const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 64, 0);
  lg.addColorStop(0, '#231613'); lg.addColorStop(0.35, '#35231f'); lg.addColorStop(0.7, '#6a524c'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#5e4842');
  g.fillStyle = lg; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const rg = g.createRadialGradient(36, 27, 1, 36, 27, 22);
  rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(215,175,150,0.75)'); rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(215,175,150,0)');
  g.fillStyle = rg; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const vg = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 64);
  vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(20,10,8,0)'); vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,10,8,0.5)');
  g.fillStyle = vg; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
});
room.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(12, 11), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: wallTex })), 0, 0.5, -5.6));

const headboard = grp('headboard');
headboard.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4.9, 4.4), bm(0x4a3028)));
headboard.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4.9, 0.2), bm(0x5f4236)), 0, 2.1, 0.01));
for (const y of [1.45, 0.85, 0.25, -0.35]) {
  headboard.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4.9, 0.05), bm(0x2f1d17)), 0, y, 0.01));
}
headboard.position.set(2.65, 0.15, -5.3);
room.add(headboard);

const mSheet = mat(0xe9e4e6, 0.9);
room.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(11, 1.5, 4.15), mSheet), 0, -3.45, 1.325));
room.add(at(ell(1.5, 0.75, 1.0, mSheet, geoB), 3.4, -1.95, -0.1));
const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 24), mat(0x2b1d19, 0.95));
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; floor.position.y = -4.2; room.add(floor);

// lamp + nightstand (single-sided panels so they vanish from behind)
const lamp = grp('lamp');
lamp.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.26, 0.4, 1.25, 20), bm(0xfff1cf)), 0.55, 1.05, -3.6));
lamp.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.09, 0.4, 10), bm(0x2a1a15)), 0.55, 0.25, -3.6));
const glowTex = canvasTex((g) => {
  g.clearRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
  const rg = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 2, 32, 32, 31);
  rg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,225,170,0.6)'); rg.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,210,150,0.22)'); rg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,140,0)');
  g.fillStyle = rg; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
});
lamp.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.8, 2.8),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: glowTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending })), 0.55, 1.05, -3.78));
lamp.add(at(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6, 4.25), bm(0x3a251e)), 0.55, -2.075, -2.95));
const nsTop = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6, 1.3), bm(0x4a3027));
nsTop.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; nsTop.position.set(0.55, 0.05, -3.6); lamp.add(nsTop);
room.add(lamp);

// ---------------- green character ----------------
const green = grp('character-green'); green.position.set(-3.45, -4.0, -2.4);
const gTorso = grp('torso'); green.add(gTorso);
const gTurn = grp('torso-turn'); gTurn.rotation.y = 0.45; gTorso.add(gTurn);

const gBodyGeo = patchSphere(C_GREEN, C_GPATCH, (x, y, z) => {
  const q = Math.sqrt(((x - 0.1) / 0.66) ** 2 + ((y - 0.12) / 0.5) ** 2);
  return (1 - sstep(0.93, 1.03, q)) * sstep(0.0, 0.2, z);
}, 80, 56);
const gBody = grp('body', ell(2.25, 3.4, 1.8, mVC, gBodyGeo)); gBody.position.set(0, 3.4, 0); gTurn.add(gBody);
const gTail = grp('tail', ell(0.38, 0.32, 0.5, mGreen)); gTail.position.set(0, 1.0, -1.3); gTurn.add(gTail);

const HEAD0 = V(0.06, 7.04, 0.6);
const HEAD_SHIFT_X = -0.14;
const HR = [1.1, 1.15, 1.0];
const gHead = grp('head', ell(HR[0], HR[1], HR[2], mGreen, geoB)); gHead.position.copy(HEAD0); gTurn.add(gHead);
const gEyes = grp('eyes'); gHead.add(gEyes);
for (const [sx, nm] of [[-1, 'eye-right'], [1, 'eye-left']]) {
  const e = makeEye(nm, 0.23, 0.15, 0.02, -0.03);
  const s = surf(HR, sx * 0.5, 0.12);
  e.position.copy(s.p).addScaledVector(s.n, -0.03);
  e.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(FWDV, s.n);
  gEyes.add(e);
}
const gMouth = grp('mouth'); gHead.add(gMouth);
{
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) {
    const x = -0.4 + 0.84 * i / 12;
    const u = (x - 0.02) / 0.42;
    const y = -0.38 - 0.09 * (1 - u * u);
    const z = HR[2] * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0001, 1 - (x / HR[0]) ** 2 - (y / HR[1]) ** 2)) + 0.004;
    pts.push(V(x, y, z));
  }
  gMouth.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts), 24, 0.024, 6, false), mMouthG));
}

const armR = makeArm('right', 1.65, 1.8, 0.42, 0.36, 0.29, 1.0);
armR.group.position.set(-0.9, 4.3, 1.45); gTurn.add(armR.group);
const armL = makeArm('left', 0.95, 0.95, 0.4, 0.33, 0.27, 0.9);
armL.group.position.set(1.2, 3.9, 1.3); gTurn.add(armL.group);

const gLegs = grp('legs'); gLegs.rotation.y = 0.45; green.add(gLegs);
for (const [sx, nm] of [[-1, 'right'], [1, 'left']]) {
  const leg = grp('leg-' + nm, ell(0.62, 0.6, 0.7, mGreen));
  leg.position.set(sx * 0.85, 0.42, 0.25);
  const foot = grp('foot-' + nm, ell(0.42, 0.2, 0.55, mHand)); foot.position.set(0, -0.42, 0.45); leg.add(foot);
  gLegs.add(leg);
}
scene.add(green);

// ---------------- pink character ----------------
const P0 = V(0.24, -1.57, 0.6);
const rel = (x, y, z) => V(x - P0.x, y - P0.y, z - P0.z);
const pink = grp('character-pink'); pink.position.copy(P0);

const BELLY_R = [2.05, 1.65, 1.1];
const BELLY_OFF = V(0.15, 0.2, 0);
const pBellyGeo = patchSphere(C_PINK, C_CREAM, (x, y, z) => sstep(0.5, 0.56, y * 0.6 + z * 0.8), 80, 56);
const pBelly = new THREE.Mesh(pBellyGeo, mVC); pBelly.name = 'belly';
pBelly.position.copy(BELLY_OFF);
pBelly.scale.set(BELLY_R[0], BELLY_R[1], BELLY_R[2]);
const pBody = grp('body', pBelly,
  at(ell(1.0, 1.05, 0.95, mPink, geoB), 2.06, -0.18, -0.1),
  at(ell(2.6, 0.62, 1.3, mPink, geoB), 0.36, -0.93, 0));
pink.add(pBody);

const PH = [1.0, 0.85, 0.9];
const pHead = grp('head', ell(PH[0], PH[1], PH[2], mPink, geoB));
pHead.position.set(2.82, 1.12, -0.1); pHead.rotation.set(-0.2, -0.25, 0);
pink.add(pHead);
const pEyes = grp('eyes'); pHead.add(pEyes);
for (const [sx, nm] of [[-1, 'eye-right'], [1, 'eye-left']]) {
  const e = makeEye(nm, 0.15, 0.09);
  e.add(at(ell(0.17, 0.1, 0.11, mPink), 0, 0.12, 0.02));
  const s = surf(PH, sx * 0.33, 0.2);
  e.position.copy(s.p).addScaledVector(s.n, -0.02);
  e.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(FWDV, s.n);
  pEyes.add(e);
}
const pMouth = grp('mouth'); pHead.add(pMouth);
{
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 12; i++) {
    const x = -0.78 + 1.0 * i / 12;
    const y = -0.3 - 0.05 * Math.sin(i / 12 * Math.PI);
    const z = PH[2] * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.0001, 1 - (x / PH[0]) ** 2 - (y / PH[1]) ** 2)) + 0.005;
    pts.push(V(x, y, z));
  }
  pMouth.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts), 24, 0.018, 6, false), mMouthP));
}
const pTufts = grp('tufts'); pHead.add(pTufts);
for (const u of [V(-0.72, 0.68, 0.12), V(-0.58, 0.8, 0.16), V(-0.84, 0.52, 0.08)]) {
  u.normalize();
  const p = V(u.x * PH[0], u.y * PH[1], u.z * PH[2]);
  const n = V(u.x / PH[0], u.y / PH[1], u.z / PH[2]).normalize();
  const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.08, 0.28, 10), mTuft);
  c.position.copy(p).addScaledVector(n, 0.1);
  c.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(UPV, n);
  pTufts.add(c);
}

const pArmL = limb('arm-left', 'hand-left', rel(2.05, -1.6, 1.3), rel(1.5, -2.3, 1.8), 0.3, [0.3, 0.26, 0.3]);
const pArmR = limb('arm-right', 'hand-right', rel(2.05, -1.6, -0.2), rel(1.5, -2.3, -0.55), 0.3, [0.3, 0.26, 0.3]);
const pLegL = limb('leg-left', 'foot-left', rel(-0.8, -1.95, 1.2), rel(-1.55, -2.3, 1.5), 0.4, [0.3, 0.24, 0.28]);
const pLegR = limb('leg-right', 'foot-right', rel(-1.1, -1.9, 0.2), rel(-1.75, -2.15, 0.3), 0.36, [0.22, 0.2, 0.22]);
pink.add(pArmL, pArmR, pLegL, pLegR);
scene.add(pink);

// ---------------- animation ----------------
const KT = [0, 400, 900, 1300, 1800, 2200, 2700, 3100, 3200];
function kf(v, t) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < 7 && t >= KT[i + 1]) i++;
  const u0 = (t - KT[i]) / (KT[i + 1] - KT[i]);
  const u = u0 * u0 * (3 - 2 * u0);
  const a = v[i], b = v[(i + 1) % 8];
  return a + (b - a) * u;
}
// wrist target in image px (hand's visible centre lands a few px further along the fingers)
const K_HX = [74, 120, 95, 122, 99, 119, 93, 98];
const K_HY = [150, 155, 157, 152, 151, 151, 131, 132];
const K_NOD = [0, 0.033, 0.045, 0.045, 0.055, 0.045, 0.045, 0.042];
const LEAN_F = 0.35;                                         // torso leans only a little; the head does the dipping
const K_HDX = [0, 0.156, 0.225, 0.225, 0.276, 0.215, 0.215, 0.193];
const K_HDY = [0, -0.196, -0.241, -0.241, -0.252, -0.241, -0.241, -0.244];
const K_PHY = [0, 0.03, 0.03, 0.09, 0.05, 0.05, 0.03, 0.03];
const K_PW = [0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0.85, 0.85];                // elbow pole blend (raised elbow -> flat arm)

const camPos = V(0, 0, CAMZ);
function bellyHit(px, py, c, r, out, nrm) {
  const dx = (px - 120) / PXU, dy = (123 - py) / PXU, dz = -CAMZ;
  const ox = camPos.x - c.x, oy = camPos.y - c.y, oz = camPos.z - c.z;
  const a = (dx / r.x) ** 2 + (dy / r.y) ** 2 + (dz / r.z) ** 2;
  const b = 2 * (ox * dx / (r.x * r.x) + oy * dy / (r.y * r.y) + oz * dz / (r.z * r.z));
  const cc = (ox / r.x) ** 2 + (oy / r.y) ** 2 + (oz / r.z) ** 2 - 1;
  const disc = b * b - 4 * a * cc;
  const s = disc > 0 ? (-b - Math.sqrt(disc)) / (2 * a) : -b / (2 * a);
  out.set(camPos.x + dx * s, camPos.y + dy * s, camPos.z + dz * s);
  nrm.set((out.x - c.x) / (r.x * r.x), (out.y - c.y) / (r.y * r.y), (out.z - c.z) / (r.z * r.z)).normalize();
}

function solveArm(arm, Tw, poleW, nW) {
  const parent = arm.group.parent;
  parent.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
  const pq = parent.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion());
  const pinv = pq.clone().invert();
  const T = parent.worldToLocal(Tw.clone());
  const pole = poleW.clone().applyQuaternion(pinv);
  const S = arm.group.position;
  const ST = T.clone().sub(S);
  const d = Math.min(Math.max(ST.length(), Math.abs(arm.L1 - arm.L2) + 0.05), (arm.L1 + arm.L2) * 0.995);
  const dir = ST.normalize();
  const a = (arm.L1 * arm.L1 - arm.L2 * arm.L2 + d * d) / (2 * d);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, arm.L1 * arm.L1 - a * a));
  const pp = pole.addScaledVector(dir, -pole.dot(dir)).normalize();
  const E = S.clone().addScaledVector(dir, a).addScaledVector(pp, h);
  const Tc = S.clone().addScaledVector(dir, d);
  const d1 = E.clone().sub(S).normalize();
  arm.group.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(DOWNV, d1);
  const d2l = Tc.clone().sub(E).normalize();
  const d2 = d2l.clone().applyQuaternion(arm.group.quaternion.clone().invert());
  arm.fore.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(DOWNV, d2);
  const fq = pq.clone().multiply(arm.group.quaternion).multiply(arm.fore.quaternion);
  const fw = d2l.applyQuaternion(pq);
  const n = nW.clone().normalize();
  const X = fw.addScaledVector(n, -fw.dot(n));
  if (X.lengthSq() < 1e-6) X.set(1, 0, 0).addScaledVector(n, -n.x);
  X.normalize();
  const Z = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(X, n).normalize();
  const qW = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(X, n, Z));
  arm.hand.quaternion.copy(fq.invert()).multiply(qW);
}

const _qa = new THREE.Quaternion(), _qb = new THREE.Quaternion(), _eu = new THREE.Euler();
const _va = V(0, 0, 0), _T = V(0, 0, 0), _N = V(0, 1, 0), _rad = V(1, 1, 1), _S = V(0, 0, 0), _T2 = V(0, 0, 0);
const _bc = V(0, 0, 0), _pole = V(0, 0, 1);
const POLE_A = V(-0.3, 0.25, 1.0), POLE_B = V(-0.5, 0.0, 1.0), POLE_L = V(0.4, 0.2, -1.0);
const L_OFF = V(0.5, -1.5, 0.45), L_NRM = V(0.1, 0.9, -0.3);

function pose(tIn) {
  const t = ((tIn % LOOP) + LOOP) % LOOP;
  const w = Math.sin(t / 1600 * Math.PI * 2);
  const nod = kf(K_NOD, t);

  // green: torso leans slightly, head stays level, slides forward and dips
  gTorso.rotation.set(0, 0, -0.38 - nod * LEAN_F);
  _qa.copy(gTorso.quaternion).multiply(gTurn.quaternion).invert();
  _qb.setFromEuler(_eu.set(0.12 + nod * 1.5, 0.22 + nod * 0.8, 0, 'YXZ'));
  gHead.quaternion.copy(_qa).multiply(_qb);
  _va.set(kf(K_HDX, t) + HEAD_SHIFT_X, kf(K_HDY, t), 0).applyQuaternion(_qa);
  gHead.position.copy(HEAD0).add(_va);

  // pink: breathing belly, small head bob, toe wiggle
  pBelly.scale.set(BELLY_R[0] * (1 - 0.004 * w), BELLY_R[1] * (1 + 0.012 * w), BELLY_R[2]);
  const ph = kf(K_PHY, t);
  pHead.position.set(2.82, 1.12 + ph, -0.1);
  pHead.rotation.set(-0.2 - ph * 0.5, -0.25, 0);
  pLegL.rotation.set(0, 0, 0.03 * w);
  pLegR.rotation.set(0, 0, -0.03 * w);

  // rubbing hand slides over the belly surface
  _bc.copy(pink.position).add(BELLY_OFF);
  _rad.set(pBelly.scale.x + 0.15, pBelly.scale.y + 0.15, pBelly.scale.z + 0.15);
  bellyHit(kf(K_HX, t), kf(K_HY, t), _bc, _rad, _T, _N);
  _pole.copy(POLE_A).lerp(POLE_B, kf(K_PW, t));
  solveArm(armR, _T, _pole, _N);

  armL.group.getWorldPosition(_S);
  _T2.copy(_S).add(L_OFF);
  solveArm(armL, _T2, POLE_L, L_NRM);
}

function render(t) {
  pose(t);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref: camera },
  characters: [green, pink],
  render,
  ready: true
};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
